title: 7x Best Sellers Ferocious | 70/30 Shortfill Bundle
description:
Ferocious Best Sellers 70/30 Shortfill Bundle:
If you’re a fan of our Ferocious 70/30 vape juices then you’re going to love this bundle! We’ve bundled together our best-selling Ferocious 70/30 Shortfills so you can save money, whilst stocking up on your favourite E-liquids for no extra cost.
Heizenberry Blast
–
A timeless classic with its unique blend of fruits, aniseed, and a super strong dose of menthol.
Vanilla Custard Delight
–
Smooth and creamy custard, sweet but not sickly, and just the right amount of warm vanilla.
Berrylicious
–
The finest medley of juicy berry flavors carefully blended together for the perfect balance of tart and sweetness.
Menthol
–
A menthol flavor that is refreshing without being harsh, and cooling but not overpowering.
Black Jack
–
Delicious blend of sweet aniseed and liquor ice with slight citrus undertones.
Fruity Menthol
–
A rich blend of sweet summer fruits complemented with a good dose of menthol.
Blackcurrant Lemonade
–
This will awaken your senses with an ice-cold blast of fresh lemons, juicy blackcurrants and plenty of fizz.
Vape juice is made with a 70/30 mix (70% VG to 30% PG). As VG is thicker than PG, you’ll need a high-powered Sub Ohm device to ensure the E-liquid is vaporized correctly. Our Ferocious Flavor’s Vape Liquids are available in a variety of quantities and intensities. 120ml short-fill Bottles of 0mg 70/30 vape juice are available.
If you want to add nicotine to your Shortfills, we have 100ml and 120ml bottles available with 3mg and 6mg nicotine strengths. We have 3mg, 6mg, 12mg, and 18mg in stock, so you can just pop it into your tank and start vaping right away!
Ingredients:
Vegetable Glycerine (70%)
Propylene Glycol (30%)
Vapoholic Flavouring
Nicotine Free, Freebase Nicotine, Or Nicotine Salts
What’s in the Bundle?
1x Heizenberry Blast Shortfill
1x Vanilla Custard Delight Shortfill
1x Berrylicious Shortfill
1x Menthol Shortfill
1x Black Jack Shortfill
1x Fruity Menthol
1x Blackcurrant Lemonade
Specifications:
Ratio
70/30
Size
100ml, 120ml
Nicotine Strength
3mg, 6mg
Flavour
Berry, Black Jack, Blackcurrant, Custard, Dessert, Fruit, Heizenberry, Lemonade, Menthol, Vanilla
Highlights:
7x best selling Ferocious e-liquids for you to try!
Delicious flavours in a 70/30 mix for sub-ohm vaping!
Perfect for cloud-chasing vapers
7 popular menthol E-liquids bundled together to save you even more money
